warnings: Axes: x = 1-1'-2-3 at 0.75 + 2.75 + 4.00 (7.50); y = A-B-C-C'-D at 2.00 + 2.00 + 2.00 + 0.50 (6.50). Origin A1. 1' and C' are PRINTED grid bubbles on every structural plan and on A-03, so they are named lines, not dummies. The same main chains print on S-01, S-02, S-03, S-04 and A-03 and all agree. Vector CAD PDF with no text layer; every figure was read off zoomed renders of the page.

Two lines are scaled, not printed (section 4 span amendment): 1'''' (x = 2.50, lower-wing roof eave where a hip and the valley end on S-04) and A' (y = -1.60, outer edge of the GS ground slab on S-02). Each carries confidence 0.7 and the scaled_from_grid flag.

Dummy naming around the printed primes: the rule name for the -1.00 x tick would be 1' and for the 4.475 y tick C', both of which are PRINTED names here, so the dummies take the next free prime (x: 1'' -1.00, 1''' 2.025, 1'''' 2.50 as one sequence off grid 1 skipping the printed 1'; y: C'' 4.475, C''' 5.00 skipping the printed C'). check_format may note these sequences as out of order — that is the printed-name skip, not an error.
Not swept for dimensions: A-04 roof plan, A-05/A-06 elevations, A-07/A-08 sections, A-09, A-10 (door/window sizes are element dimensions), E-01, SN-01/02. Their ticks are not in this master.
Room-tag ceiling height of ห้องน้ำ on A-03 was not read in full and is not recorded in unassigned_dimensions.

dummy_grid_rule_check.negative_pos_m: x: 1'' = -1.00 (roof eave left of grid 1). y: A' -1.60, A'' -1.50, A''' -1.00 before row A, primed in reading order top to bottom.
